short_message:
{Hi|Hello} - quick question, slightly awkward one.

Most antique and jewellery dealers list by hand. The real cost isn't the time - it's the pieces that should have sold in a week and sat there for three months instead.

We fix that side of it. You keep sourcing, you keep selling.

How many things are on your shelf right now that should already be gone?

Daniel - Easy Listings
www.easylistings.co.uk
_contact_paths_notes: CMS-specific paths matter. Shopify uses /pages/contact (and /contact 404s). WordPress uses /contact-us/ and /pages/. Squarespace uses /contact-1 or /contact. Try the platform paths, not just the generic ones.
